messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick sync thread for the "Gratitude Cards + Mini-Spot" pop-up next Wed. We're pairing handwritten cards with $50 instant awards at lobby kiosks. Need final volunteer list, supply pickup, and payroll routing confirmed by Mon noon.
Connor (Office Ops): I can pick up 200 cards + pens from vendor. Where should we store them? Front desk or Ops closet?
Maya (People Ops): Ops closet is fine; label box GRATITUDE_POPUP. Also need a table sign and QR code to the nomination form.
Riley (Eng): I'll staff the 11:30-1 shift with two teammates. Happy to manage the QR scanning flow.
Connor (Office Ops): Cool. I'll bring a card scanner + card stock stand.
Eli (Payroll): For $50 instant awards: prefer prepaid cards batch. Need recipient email and manager_approver_email by Tue 5pm to hit vendor cutoff (48h). If recipient is international, we need country to pick local vendor.
Sasha (Finance): Budget: use GL RECOG-POPUP-2026. Ops, include budget_code column in the export. Also we need to cap per-person frequency (max 2 pop-up awards per quarter) to avoid aggregation issues.
Maya (People Ops): We'll enforce cap in the form: block submission if it exceeds 2 in 90 days unless ops override.
Riley (Eng): UX ask: can the QR form prefill team/org if we detect from SSO link? Makes sign-up faster at the kiosk.
Maya (People Ops): We'll use a short URL with UTM that prepopulates org/team where possible.
Connor (Office Ops): Logistics: need two clipboards, signage, a small lockbox for cards, and a volunteer checklist. I'll add those to pickup.
Eli (Payroll): Vendor test: send test.recipient+popup@redwood.ai and vendor TEST-VEND-POP to verify card delivery timing. I'll confirm within 24h.
Maya (People Ops): Test user posted above. Also we'll collect opt-in for public shoutout on the form. If opt-out, ops will not post to #wins.
Sasha (Finance): Please ensure export CSV headers: recipient_name,recipient_email,org,team,amount_usd,budget_code,manager_approver_email,recipient_country,public_shoutout,submission_ts. Finance will validate GL codes by Tue 3pm.
Riley (Eng): Can we print a short script for volunteers: "Hi! Leave a quick note and scan the QR for a $50 instant thank you. Choices: public shoutout or private." Keeps flow smooth.
Connor (Office Ops): Adding script to checklist. Also confirm kiosk hours: 10:30-2:30, table in lobby A.
Maya (People Ops): Announce-bot will post manager heads-up Mon 9am. Volunteers please add availability to the shared sheet.
announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Gratitude Cards + Mini-Spot pop-up -> Mon manager heads-up at 9:00 AM PT"
Eli (Payroll): Final reminder: any award >$600 aggregated will need tax flag. Ops, please run dedupe and cumulative check before export.
Maya (People Ops): Will do. Thank you everyone 97 I'll post the QR link, volunteer roster, and the export template here by EOD today.
Connor (Office Ops): I'll label and lock the supply box. See y'all Wed!
